about: 15 arithmetic cases for scripts/rig.py, each worked out by hand in its 'what'. They run offline: no network, no model. 'args' is the command line; 'expect' maps a dotted path in rig.py's --json output to the hand-worked answer (numbers match to 0.001; null must be null). 'assumptions_include' lists text that must appear in the printed assumptions. 'error' means rig.py must refuse (exit 2) and print nothing.

cases.what: 10 gal, 2 people, default 1 gal each a day: 2 gal a day, 5 days
12 gal, 3 people at 1.5: 4.5 a day, 12/4.5 = 2.667 days; 3 nights need 13.5, short 1.5
21 gal at the default 13 mpg: 273 miles; a third is 91
21 gal at 10 mpg, 120 miles counted: range 210; needs 12 gal; 9 left, 9/21 = 42.857 percent
10 gal at 15 mpg, 200 miles: range 150; needs 13.333; short 3.333
1200 Wh battery, usable 0.5 = 600; lights 20x5 = 100 + fridge 50x12 = 600, so 700 a day; no solar, net -700; 600/700 = 0.857 days
same, plus 200 W of panels at the defaults (4 sun hours, 0.7): 200x4x0.7 = 560; net -140; 600/140 = 4.286 days
Starlink alone, 8 h at the default 50 W = 400 Wh a day; 1000 Wh x 0.5 = 500; 500/400 = 1.25 days
lamp 30x10 = 300 a day; 300 W panels x4x0.7 = 840; net +540; the battery is not drawn down (null)
all numbers given: heater 100x15 = 1500; 100 W x5 sun x1.0 = 500; net -1000; 2000 Wh x1.0 = 2000; 2 days; no assumptions
all: water 10 gal, 2 people, 4 nights = 5 days; gas 21 gal = 273 mi; power 1200 Wh, fridge 600 a day, usable 600 = 1.0 day
a load with no hours is refused
